def parse_port(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text or not text.isascii() or not text.isdecimal():
        return None
    digits = text.lstrip("0")
    if not digits or len(digits) > 5:
        return None
    port = int(digits)
    return port if port <= 65535 else None
